briefings.title: 🟢Iran Vs America war live: Trump says Hormuz operation paused amid US, Tehran talks| Khamenei |N18G
briefings.tldr: Amidst paused US military operations in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran has bypassed the maritime blockade by shifting its China-bound oil exports to overland rail networks and has rejected direct talks with Washington, opting instead for a multilateral mediation strategy involving Russia, Oman, and Pakistan.
